name: extreme-hourglass-selfie-in-vintage-boudoir
image_purpose: Vintage fashion selfie and bedroom moodboard

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic raw smartphone selfie in an elegant vintage bedroom.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult blonde woman with bangs and voluminous waves, silver earrings, natural visible pores, and a calm direct expression. She wears a light-blue off-shoulder ruffled crop top, matching opaque lace-trimmed shorts, a ruffled leg accessory, and light-blue pointed-toe heels, kneeling comfortably on the carpet while holding a smartphone.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 2:3 mirror-selfie composition with the subject kneeling in a relaxed fashion pose, elegant toile de Jouy curtains, cream fringed sofa, patterned carpet, and warm bedroom furniture. Preserve the phone and mirror reflection logic.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft indoor ambient lighting with vintage film glow, gentle shadows on the carpet and ruffles, cozy refined bedroom atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: iPhone 15 Pro Max look, 2:3 vertical, raw unfiltered sharp selfie detail, realistic skin and fabric texture, subtle film grain, natural color and believable reflection.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An ultra-photorealistic raw 2:3 smartphone mirror selfie of one approved adult blonde woman with bangs and voluminous waves, silver earrings, visible natural pores, and a calm direct expression. She wears a light-blue off-shoulder ruffled crop top, matching opaque lace-trimmed shorts, a ruffled leg accessory, and light-blue pointed-toe heels, kneeling comfortably on an elegant patterned carpet while holding a smartphone. Include toile de Jouy curtains, a cream-colored fringed sofa, warm vintage bedroom furniture, soft ambient light with vintage film glow, realistic ruffle and skin texture, subtle grain, and cozy refined fashion mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, lingerie, garter fetish, sexualized crawl, exaggerated body proportions, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, broken reflection, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur
